verdict.rationale: Aider's docs say you can switch models mid-session with the in-chat /model command. They also cover local models via Ollama or any OpenAI-compatible API, and an architect/editor mode that pairs two different models. Community reports confirm real use with OpenAI, Anthropic Claude and Gemini 2.5 Pro; one user's tokenizer error with a Claude model is an isolated setup issue, not a refutation, since others report Claude working with automatic retries. Missing for 10: a first-party list of supported hosted providers and documentation of the --model startup flag and provider API-key setup.
